newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo in agreement to sell Chevys chain.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo in agreement to sell Chevys chain.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc said on Thursday it has reached agreement to sell its Chevys chain of Mexican restaurants to an undisclosed buyer.

Terms of the deal for the 70-restaurant chain were not provided. The deal is part of PepsiCo's planned sale of its casual-dining restaurant chains, which it is divesting before it spins off its three fast-food chains, KFC, Taco Bell and Pizza Hut, as a separate company later this year.

PepsiCo said it has completed the sale of its East Side Mario's and Hot 'n Now chains, and is in active discussions with potential buyers for California Pizza Kitchens and for PFS, its restaurant distribution company.
